evidence.title: GitHub - pipecat-ai/voice-ui-kit: Components, hooks and template apps for building React voice AI applications quickly.

name: Pipecat Voice UI Kit
summary: React components, hooks and template apps for building voice AI applications.
description: A React UI kit for voice AI apps: 21 components covering audio controls, conversation and transcripts, device selection, a DTMF keypad and an AI thinking state, plus 6 hooks, two template apps (Console, Widget) and three audio visualizers. Built on Tailwind 4 and styled with CSS variables so the built-in theme can be extended or replaced.
contains: 21 components incl. audio controls, conversation, transcript overlay, device select, DTMF keypad
3 audio visualizers: basic, circular waveform, plasma (WebGL)
Tailwind 4 with CSS variables and responsive layout
